title: Which one fails?
examObjective: Converting between output types and data types using DataWeave
prompt: Three of these run. **One fails.** Which one?

explanation.approach: The text/plain writer only writes a String. To put structured data into a text output, serialise it to a String yourself with `write`.

snippets.label: The one that fails
snippets.note: Text plain writer is unable to write Object.

snippets.label: write returns a String
snippets.note: That String is something text/plain can write.
